arguments.summary: A spear-phishing campaign attributed to APT-41 (Double Dragon) successfully compromised a high-criticality finance workstation (WS-FIN-042). Initial access was achieved via a malicious PowerShell payload launched from Outlook, leading to the execution of a ShadowPad variant through DLL sideloading via rundll32.exe. The malware established C2 communication over HTTPS to a known malicious IP (198.51.100.23), performed host file modification for persistence, and attempted lateral movement via SMB. The threat was contained by blocking the C2 IP at the firewall, resetting the compromised user's credentials, and executing a hardening playbook. Full endpoint scan confirmed the presence of the initial payload and a separate exploit (CVE-2024-3094).

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_API_Loading {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beacon through dynamic API resolution pattern"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-09"
        hash = "a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2"
    strings:
        $api_hash_calc = { 8B 45 ?? 50 E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 83 C4 04 3B C3 75 ?? 8B 45 ?? 50 E8 ?? ?? ?? ?? } // Common hash-based API resolution
        $beacon_config = { 2E 74 65 78 74 00 00 00 [1-4] 00 00 00 00 [1-4] 24 43 53 52 43 } // .text section + $CSCRC marker
    condition:

}
